text: {"frames":["The mill wheel on the third floor of the Tower is turning, and not one thread stirs in the still air. Gareth the mapmaker stands at the sluice with ink on his fingers, because the canal he drew yesterday has filled with water overnight. The gate-lever only lifts when the two brass plates on the wall agree in a certain way. The left plate shows {a} and the right plate shows {b}, and the water is already lapping at his boots. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}?","Marijke pulls the stopper from a jar and a grey fog curls out and drifts toward the tulip-coloured stairs. Behind her, the crooked house by the lock groans as its hoist beam swings on its own. A tin label on the jar is scratched with two numbers, {a} and {b}, and the fog only settles when the sign between them is right. Her friend the cheese maker is waiting below with a wheel of cheese and a hungry cat. What sign goes between {a} and {b}?","The smell of hot waffles drifts up the stairs of the Tower, though the kitchen is cold and empty. Every window of the house with the hoist beam is glowing, and a soft knock comes from inside the beam itself. Fenna the bell-ringer of the drowned village has climbed up to see who keeps lighting the lamps. On the wall beside the bell rope someone has chalked {a} on one side and {b} on the other. Which sign stands between {a} and {b}?","Every night a new shadow appears on the white wall of the Tower, shaped like a windmill with one sail missing. Fenna the bell-ringer climbs up with her lantern and finds the shadow already moving toward the stairs, quick as a fox. The shadow is always chasing the sound of the bells, and the bells ring once for each number written on the post. Here the post reads {a} and {b}, and the shadow is nearly at the door. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}?","An old stork called Joop lands on the rail of the Tower bridge, carrying a map that nobody in Misty Ford remembers drawing. He wants a canal drawn through the frozen meadow, and he wants it badly enough to trade his best fish for it. The map shows a stream with two marks on its bank, {a} and {b}, and the ice is cracking underneath them. Joop cannot tell which way the water runs unless the sign between them is put in place. What sign goes between {a} and {b}?"]}
